**c3: CHANGELOG.md has a new bullet under 'Unreleased'**
Accepted.
The diff at fcfdfe5 shows the new bullet under "Unreleased". It describes the Kelvin support and when ValueError is raised.

**Where EVAL-17 stands:** all 3 criteria are proven and the done check passes. The work item is still "In Progress", and the people or agents doing the work need to move it.
